title: Lock the v2 rules and the API contract
body:
## Goal

Agree the rules and every request/response shape before splitting, so both halves can be built in parallel without waiting on each other.

## Tasks

- [ ] Read docs/api.md together and resolve any open question
- [ ] Confirm stops, cast, verbs, claim types and tick order match the design doc
- [ ] Agree field names the client needs that are missing (e.g. labels for buttons)

## Done when

docs/api.md has no open questions and both of you have approved the PR that finalises it.

## Owner

Tobi (@coderback) and Ahmed (@AhmedBokaniUsman)

## Reference

Design doc: *The Crypt Road v2* (shared by Tobi), section “API contract for the client”. API shapes: `docs/api.md`.

title: Generate client fixtures from the rules model
body:
## Goal

Give the client realistic canned responses for every demo beat, generated from the same model the acceptance test uses.

## Tasks

- [ ] Write tools/make_fixtures.py that plays the demo route in tools/crypt_road_sim.py
- [ ] Dump state, allowed and act responses per beat into fixtures/ in the docs/api.md shapes
- [ ] Add a test that fixtures are regenerated without diff (or document the command)

## Done when

fixtures/ holds one state/allowed/act set per demo beat and the client can load them.

## Owner

Tobi (@coderback)

title: Deploy a hello-world with a persistent volume
body:
## Goal

Find hosting problems now, not at hour 20. SQLite must survive restarts on the host.

## Tasks

- [ ] Pick Fly.io or Railway, EU region, with a persistent volume
- [ ] Deploy a FastAPI app with GET /health
- [ ] Write a file to the volume, restart the machine, confirm it is still there
- [ ] Note the public URL and deploy command in the README

## Done when

The public URL returns {"ok": true} and a file written before a restart is still there after it.

## Owner

Tobi (@coderback)

title: Claim credits and benchmark model providers
body:
## Goal

Choose a primary and a backup model on measured speed and reliability from the host.

## Tasks

- [ ] Claim the hackathon credits and note balances and expiry
- [ ] From the host, send 20 calls per candidate with a real state pack, JSON mode, max_tokens 150, thinking off
- [ ] Record p50/p95 latency and % valid picks in docs/models.md
- [ ] Primary: lowest p95 with >=95% valid and p95 < 3 s; backup from a different provider
- [ ] Set LLM_* and LLM_BACKUP_* env vars on the host; if no credits by 12:00, use a cheap paid key

## Done when

docs/models.md names the primary and backup with their numbers, and both keys work from the host.

## Owner

Tobi (@coderback)

## Reference

Design doc: *The Crypt Road v2* (shared by Tobi), section “Kickoff and submission”. API shapes: `docs/api.md`.

title: Client skeleton, assets and fixture loader
body:

## Tasks

- [ ] Choose plain canvas or Phaser (your call) and scaffold client/ with a package.json (lint/test/build scripts)

- [ ] Load fixtures/ through a small API module that can later point at the real engine

The client starts locally, renders the stub state, and CI's client job runs your scripts.

## Goal

Implement the v2 rules so the engine matches the reference model exactly.

title: Caps, rate limits and graceful degradation
body:
## Goal

Judges clicking everything must never break the site or the credits.

## Tasks

- [ ] Per-session cap (start at 60) and a global cap from the credit balance
- [ ] At most 4 concurrent model calls; 5 new sessions per IP per hour
- [ ] Cap hit, 401/402/429 or timeout -> fallback and state.brain = 'fallback' for the 'offline brain' badge
- [ ] Limit free text to 200 characters

## Done when
